A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same i-CIR dataset and BASIC retrieval method. All 38 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, support comparison; appendix renumbering and relocated material can be matched.

before.justification: v1 Section 5 and Appendix D report original retrieval experiments, component ablations, sensitivity analyses and timing measurements for BASIC.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix E, including benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: BASIC retains the same centering, semantic projection, query expansion, text contextualization, normalization and Harris fusion procedures. The technical appendix is renumbered from C to D without changing the method.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same i-CIR, domain-conversion and conventional CIR benchmarks, including the refined CIRR/FashionIQ evaluations and query-rewriting scenarios. The datasets newly discussed in v2 Appendix B are related work, not added evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding main and appendix comparisons. FreeDom receives a corrected reference, but its named comparator rows, participation and reported scores remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the same backbones, evaluation metrics, hyperparameters and experimental procedures. The i-CIR development split remains 15 instances, 92 composed queries and 45K images; appendix relocation introduces no protocol changes.

E4.justification: The component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, unimodal analyses, corpus comparisons, collection-bias check and query-style robustness tests are retained. v1 Appendix D and v2 Appendix E contain the same analyses and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, experimental random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for the retrieval scores.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical entries, rankings, curves and qualitative retrieval results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains BASIC's 31.64% i-CIR macro-mAP and 34.35% without query expansion; Tables D1-D10 become E1-E10 with the same results.

T1.justification: The covariance projection, normalization and fusion equations, query-side computational equivalence, positive-eigenvalue selection and query-expansion derivation are mathematically unchanged. Appendix equation renumbering adds no theoretical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about the instance-level i-CIR benchmark, its challenging hard negatives, and BASIC's training-free design and strong retrieval performance. Contribution scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of modality imbalance, contextualization and query-style sensitivity are retained. The stated limitations of i-CIR and BASIC, including complementary-modality assumptions and privacy concerns, are relocated or renumbered without substantive revision.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, corpus sizes, synthetic normalization-data construction, hyperparameters and query-expansion details are unchanged. The project-page link and stated release/access information also remain the same.

R1.justification: v2 adds Appendix B surveying instance-level retrieval benchmarks, including UKB, Holidays, GPR1200, UnED and ILIAS. It also replaces the diffusion-paper reference attached to FreeDom with Composed image retrieval for training-free domain conversion. This expands background and corrects attribution without redefining the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Appendices heading and a short related-work appendix, shifting the previous Appendices B-D to C-E and updating cross-references. Existing exposition is essentially unchanged, alongside limited heading and bibliographic editing.

P2.justification: Figure 2 has small spacing adjustments, and appendix reflow repositions existing displays, including Table D1/E1 and Figure D6/E6. Figures and tables are renumbered, but their structures and visual evidence are retained.

improvement.justification: The added instance-level retrieval survey supplies relevant background missing from v1, while the FreeDom citation correction improves attribution of an evaluated baseline. These provide a limited improvement in scholarly context and accuracy; the method, empirical evidence and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
